name: SiYuan
description: SiYuan is a privacy-first personal knowledge management system with block-based editing, Markdown support, bidirectional links, flashcards, databases, and browser-based Docker hosting.

notes.text: The access authorization code is stored in `/opt/siyuan/.env` as `SIYUAN_AUTH_CODE`.
Docker-hosted SiYuan supports browser access only; desktop and mobile app connections are not supported in this mode.
Export to PDF/HTML/Word and Markdown import are not supported in the Docker-hosted mode documented by SiYuan.
